description: Backend Benchmarks - Run benchmarks for the backend directory, identify slow operations, root-cause them, and fix.

userStories.title: Set up benchmark infrastructure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need pytest-benchmark installed and a benchmark test directory so I can write and run benchmarks.
acceptanceCriteria: pytest-benchmark added to pyproject.toml dev dependencies
backend/tests/benchmarks/ directory created with __init__.py and conftest.py
conftest.py has shared fixtures (mock DB session, sample data factories)
uv run pytest tests/benchmarks/ --benchmark-only runs without errors
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Benchmark repository layer operations
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to benchmark all repo CRUD operations to identify slow database patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: Benchmarks for memory_repo: create, list (100/500/1000), search, delete
Benchmarks for thread repo: create, list, get with messages
Benchmarks for assistant repo: create, list
Benchmarks for tool_repo: list, lookup by name
All benchmarks produce timing data with ops/sec
Any operation >100ms flagged in output
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Benchmark API route handlers
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to benchmark API endpoints to identify slow routes and serialization overhead.
acceptanceCriteria: Benchmarks for health, threads, assistants, memory, llm, tools routes
Uses FastAPI TestClient with mocked dependencies
Measures serialization overhead (route time vs repo time)
Any endpoint >200ms flagged
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Benchmark service layer and agent initialization
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to benchmark service-layer logic to find CPU-bound bottlenecks.
acceptanceCriteria: Benchmarks for agent initialization, tool resolution, prompt assembly
Benchmarks for Pydantic schema serialization/validation on large payloads
Service benchmarks isolate business logic from I/O
Any operation >50ms flagged
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Optimize slow operations and document results
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to fix any slow operations found and document before/after results.
acceptanceCriteria: All operations exceeding thresholds have documented root causes
Fixes implemented (eager loading, indexes, caching, serialization optimization as needed)
Before/after benchmark comparison documented in backend/BENCHMARKS.md
All tests still pass after optimizations
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Push all changes for code review
userStories.description: As a developer, I want all benchmark code and optimizations committed and pushed so reviewers can see the work.
acceptanceCriteria: All changes committed with descriptive commit messages
Branch pushed to origin
PR #839 updated with benchmark results summary in description
All CI checks pass
userStories.notes: Final step — push everything to feat/838-backend-benchmarks
